chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: ReSOLVE is an agentic customer support platform. It triages tickets by intent, priority, and sentiment, drafts replies grounded in a knowledge base, attaches citations and a confidence score, and leaves the send decision to a human.

chunks.heading: Pipeline
chunks.text: The pipeline is ticket intake, guardrails, a triage agent, RAG drafting, and a human decision. Inbound webhooks are HMAC-verified and idempotent, and notifications run through Celery with Redis.

chunks.heading: Retrieval and data
chunks.text: RAG drafting retrieves from a FAISS inner-product index over a Markdown knowledge base. PostgreSQL stores tickets, users, sessions, and the audit trail in production; SQLite is the local stand-in.

chunks.heading: Guardrails
chunks.text: ReSOLVE fails closed. If the model call fails, triage falls back to deterministic rules so the ticket still routes. Guardrails check inputs before the model sees text and check drafts before they reach the queue. There is no autonomous send path.

chunks.heading: Tradeoffs
chunks.text: The main tradeoffs: retrieval can abstain more often than free generation, the deterministic fallback has to stay aligned with the agent, and human review puts pressure on queue speed. FAISS is simple to operate but has no managed hybrid search.

chunks.heading: Outcome
chunks.text: ReSOLVE is built, not a measured deployment. The case study states that resolution rate, time saved, deflection, and production traffic cannot be claimed without a deployment and a baseline.

chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: Powerlift is a mobile biomechanics analyzer for powerlifting. It uses YOLOv8 pose estimation, Kalman filtering, engineered landmark features, and an SVM to classify squat, bench, and deadlift phases and score reps.

chunks.heading: Pipeline
chunks.text: The on-device pipeline is camera frame, YOLOv8 pose, Kalman filter, landmark features, SVM classifier, then a lift score and UI. Frames are never uploaded.

chunks.heading: Decisions
chunks.text: Powerlift favors one pose model over a heavier stack, a Kalman filter over raw landmarks, and a small SVM over a sequence model. The tradeoffs are keypoint precision, per-lift filter tuning, and hand-engineered features.

chunks.heading: Outcome
chunks.text: Powerlift was built as a mobile application and named Overall Best Thesis in 2025. No accuracy or FPS benchmark was published, so the case study does not quote those numbers.

chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: Sunny AI is a RAG-built mentor for aspiring AI engineers, made with React, Python, FastAPI, LLMs, and LangChain. It guides learners from fundamentals through production skills and real-world readiness.

chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: The AI Resume Analyzer is an NLP pipeline that extracts skills and experience from resumes with spaCy named-entity recognition and transformer semantic matching, then emits structured JSON for ranking or ATS use.

chunks.heading: Performance
chunks.text: The resume analyzer processes more than 100 documents per minute and is built with Python and FastAPI.

chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: The Document Summarizer performs abstractive summarization on multi-page PDFs with BART and T5 from Hugging Face. It chunks long documents to fit context limits and merges section summaries into one coherent output.
